name: OpenSSH
grade_reasons: Only 40% of the evidence is measurable
Cannot measure development practices (the GitHub repository is a mirror; development happens elsewhere)
Cannot measure unfixed vulnerabilities (5 advisories carry no fix data)
Cannot measure fix speed (no release dates for fixes)
grade_strengths: Contains formally proved components (libcrux); the rest of its code is not proved

verified.name: libcrux
verified.what: mlkem768x25519-sha256 key exchange uses ML-KEM-768 C extracted from libcrux (libcrux_mlkem768_sha3.h: 'Extracted from libcrux revision 84c5d87...'); the default KEX since OpenSSH 10.0 (2025-04-09)
verified.caveat: The proofs cover the Rust source; the C in OpenSSH comes from Eurydice, a Rust-to-C translator that is not itself proved.

verified.name: libcrux
verified.what: combined libcrux ML-KEM + ML-DSA extraction (libcrux-mlkem-mldsa.c, 2026-06-14), backing the experimental ssh-mldsa44-ed25519 composite signature added in 10.4
verified.caveat: The proofs cover the Rust source; the C in OpenSSH comes from Eurydice, a Rust-to-C translator that is not itself proved.
